name: quality-kit
description: Resolve static-analysis findings with one default strategy instead of re-deciding on every PR: collect a PR's or repository's findings from a provider into one provider-neutral record (Codacy or SonarQube Cloud), then decide per finding whether to fix, suppress inline, ignore, exclude a path or change a pattern, with decision rights, required reasons, a baseline-versus-new rule, a verify-after-push loop, a local pre-PR scan and an author checklist for new scripts. Also answers Codecov questions and sets up a coverage tier check on patch coverage (coverage.py JSON, Cobertura or LCOV) for any repository, and measures test strength with mutmut in an isolated copy of the working tree, proposing a test or an inline pragma for each surviving mutant (measured data, never a gate). Collecting only reads the provider and writes its record to the session scratchpad; every remote Codacy or Sonar write goes through an explicit approval.
